017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.hocon;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.CollectionUtils.*;
020
021import java.lang.annotation.*;
022import java.lang.reflect.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.commons.reflect.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.commons.svl.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
028
029/**
030 * Utility classes and methods for the {@link HoconApply @HoconApply} annotation.
031 *
032 */
033public class HoconApplyAnnotation {
034
035   /**
036    * Prevents instantiation.
037    */
038   private HoconApplyAnnotation() {}
039
040   /**
041    * Applies targeted {@link HoconApply} annotations to a {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.Context.Builder}.
042    */
043   @SuppressWarnings({
044      "rawtypes" // Raw types required for reflective annotation application.
045   })
046   public static class Applier extends AnnotationApplier<HoconApply,Context.Builder> {
047
048      /**
049       * Constructor.
050       *
051       * @param vr The resolver for resolving values in annotations.
052       *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
053       */
054      public Applier(VarResolverSession vr) {
055         super(HoconApply.class, Context.Builder.class, vr);
056      }
057
058      @Override
059      public void apply(AnnotationInfo<HoconApply> ai, Context.Builder b) {
060         HoconApply a = ai.inner();
061         if (isEmptyArray(a.on()) && isEmptyArray(a.onClass()))
062            return;
063         b.annotations(a);
064      }
065   }
066
067   /**
068    * Builder class.
069    *
070    * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
071    *    <li class='jm'>{@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.MarshallingContext.Builder#annotations(Annotation...)}
072    * </ul>
073    */
074   public static class Builder extends AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderTMF {
075
076      Hocon value = HoconAnnotation.DEFAULT;
077
078      /**
079       * Constructor.
080       */
081      protected Builder() {
082         super(HoconApply.class);
083      }
084
085      /**
086       * Sets the {@link HoconApply#value()} property on this annotation.
087       *
088       * @param value The new value for this property.
089       * @return This object.
090       */
091      public Builder value(Hocon value) {
092         this.value = value;
093         return this;
094      }
095
096      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.Builder */
097      public Builder on(String...value) {
098         super.on(value);
099         return this;
100      }
101
102      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderT */
103      public Builder on(Class<?>...value) {
104         super.on(value);
105         return this;
106      }
107
108      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedOnClassAnnotationObject.Builder */
109      public Builder onClass(Class<?>...value) {
110         super.onClass(value);
111         return this;
112      }
113
114      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderM */
115      public Builder on(Method...value) {
116         super.on(value);
117         return this;
118      }
119
120      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderMF */
121      public Builder on(Field...value) {
122         super.on(value);
123         return this;
124      }
125
126      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderT */
127      public Builder on(ClassInfo...value) {
128         super.on(value);
129         return this;
130      }
131
132      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderT */
133      public Builder onClass(ClassInfo...value) {
134         super.onClass(value);
135         return this;
136      }
137
138      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderTMF */
139      public Builder on(FieldInfo...value) {
140         super.on(value);
141         return this;
142      }
143
144      @Override /* Overridden from AppliedAnnotationObject.BuilderTMF */
145      public Builder on(MethodInfo...value) {
146         super.on(value);
147         return this;
148      }
149
150      /**
151       * Instantiates a new {@link HoconApply @HoconApply} object initialized with this builder.
152       *
153       * @return A new {@link HoconApply} object.
154       */
155      public HoconApply build() {
156         return new Object(this);
157      }
158   }
159
160   @SuppressWarnings({
161      "java:S2160" // equals() inherited from AnnotationObject compares all annotation interface methods; subclass fields are accessed via those methods
162   })
163   private static class Object extends AppliedOnClassAnnotationObject implements HoconApply {
164
165      private final Hocon value;
166
167      Object(HoconApplyAnnotation.Builder b) {
168         super(b);
169         value = b.value;
170      }
171
172      @Override /* Overridden from HoconApply */
173      public Hocon value() {
174         return value;
175      }
176   }
177
178   /** Default value */
179   public static final HoconApply DEFAULT = create().build();
180
181   /**
182    * Instantiates a new builder for this class.
183    *
184    * @return A new builder object.
185    */
186   public static Builder create() {
187      return new Builder();
188   }
189
190   /**
191    * Instantiates a new builder for this class.
192    *
193    * @param on The targets this annotation applies to.
194    * @return A new builder object.
195    */
196   public static Builder create(Class<?>...on) {
197      return create().on(on);
198   }
199
200   /**
201    * Instantiates a new builder for this class.
202    *
203    * @param on The targets this annotation applies to.
204    * @return A new builder object.
205    */
206   public static Builder create(String...on) {
207      return create().on(on);
208   }
209
210   /**
211    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if the specified annotation contains all default values.
212    *
213    * @param a The annotation to check.
214    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>true</jk>).
215    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the specified annotation contains all default values.
216    */
217   public static boolean empty(HoconApply a) {
218      return a == null || DEFAULT.equals(a);
219   }
220}
